_comment: Threshold requirements, Arizona 2026 and 2027 QAP. Section IV Threshold Eligibility, PDF pp.10-16, plus the 4% bond issuance limitation in V.A.2. IV.B.4 (rehab income and rent targeting: the more restrictive of the set-aside or other program rules) is not extracted separately. Exhibit A design standards (pp.33-44) are incorporated by IV.A but are not itemised.

criteria.heading: Pre-application workshop attendance (9%)
criteria.quote: a minimum of one (1) representative of each Applicant must attend ADOH

criteria.heading: Qualified contract waiver
criteria.quote: the Applicant waives the right to request a qualified contract

criteria.heading: Plan submittal and construction start dates (9%)
criteria.quote: Applicants must provide evidence to ADOH that the local jurisdiction has received building plans by
criteria.note: Plans by December 31 of the award year and construction under way by December 31 of the following year; principals who miss the start date cannot apply in the next 9% round.

criteria.heading: Applicant experience
criteria.quote: The Applicant or project consultant must have been listed in an awarded application form as a developer

criteria.heading: Principals: disqualification grounds
criteria.quote: ADOH may disqualify an application based on substantive evidence that a Principal:
criteria.note: Includes bankruptcy in five years, adverse fair housing judgments, unpaid ADOH fees or loans, and unapproved changes of general partner on a prior project.

criteria.heading: LIHTC management experience
criteria.quote: a management company for at least three (3) LIHTC properties

criteria.heading: Site control
criteria.quote: Applications must include a legally binding contract of either current ownership or the legal ability to
criteria.note: Tribal land requires a lease or agreement to lease for 25 years with a 25-year renewal option.

criteria.heading: Market need
criteria.quote: Applications must include a study prepared by a market analyst on ADOH

criteria.heading: Funding source commitments
criteria.quote: Applications must include executed commitment letters for all funding sources, other than ADOH loans

criteria.heading: Minimum set-aside; average income limits
criteria.quote: Applications must indicate the property’s minimum set-aside, which cannot change after submission.
criteria.note: Average income projects may not include market-rate units or designations above 60% AMI for any bedroom type.

criteria.heading: Public housing and HCV waitlist notification
criteria.quote: the management company will inform the local public housing authority and Housing Choice Voucher

criteria.heading: Smoke-free development
criteria.quote: Applicants must enforce a “no smoking” policy

criteria.heading: Community Wi-Fi
criteria.quote: Applicants must provide Wi-Fi in air-conditioned common areas throughout the project that is entirely

criteria.heading: Construction completion and payment security
criteria.quote: All projects must maintain construction completion and payment security as a condition of reservation,
criteria.note: 100% performance and payment bonds, or ADOH-approved alternative security, under Exhibit C, effective October 1, 2026.

criteria.heading: Scope of work and capital needs assessment
criteria.quote: Applicants for rehabilitation, including all adaptive reuse projects, must submit a detailed Capital Needs

criteria.heading: Minimum rehabilitation per unit
criteria.quote: Buildings must require an average of at least $25,000 per unit in rehabilitation hard costs,
criteria.note: $25,000 qualifies but scores 0 under V.B.2, which starts paying at $30,001.

criteria.quote: ADOH may deem an application ineligible due to proximity
criteria.note: Half-mile and adjacency tests for airports, landfills, industrial uses, jails and similar.

criteria.heading: Floodplain and wetlands
criteria.quote: has any portion on a 100-year floodplain

criteria.heading: Zoning in place
criteria.quote: are in place for the proposed property.

criteria.heading: Utility connections and road access
criteria.quote: all necessary utilities are currently available or connections are possible, and

criteria.heading: 9% income and rent targeting at or below 50% AMI average
criteria.quote: For 9% LIHTC applications, the average income and rent restrictions of the low-income units (not
criteria.note: Filed under the New Construction threshold heading but worded for all 9% applications. It is stricter than IV.A.10, which caps average income designations at 60% AMI for any bedroom type.

criteria.heading: Minimum score of 160 (9%)
criteria.quote: Applications under the competitive 9% LIHTC round must have a minimum total score of one hundred
criteria.note: 160 of 185 for Rural and Metro new construction (86%), 160 of 210 for Tribal. Filed under the New Construction heading but worded for 'the competitive 9% LIHTC round'; if it also binds rehab, it is 160 of 170.

criteria.heading: Private activity bond issuance limitation (4%)
criteria.quote: The amount of private activity bond volume cap allocated, as specified in the ADOH Bond Certification
criteria.note: The greater of 30% of aggregate eligible basis or the amount needed to support maximum permanent debt. 4% applications are not scored and are funded first come, first served.
